rss: Rent rises set to speed up in gloomy forecast for tenants
title: Rent Costs Expected to Increase
story: The price for renting treehouses is going up! Treehouse owners say it will cost more to live in them soon.
storyBig: The cost of renting treehouses is anticipated to rise by 4% to 5% annually. This forecast presents challenges for families seeking affordable housing.
think: Why do you think renting prices might go up?
bull: Some people might build more treehouses to meet demand.
bear: Higher costs could make it harder for families to find affordable homes.

rss: Pubs, hotels and gyms in Wales to get 30% business rates cut
title: Big Savings for Adventure Park Owners
story: Adventure parks are getting a big discount on their business bills. This means they might have extra money to make parks even more fun.
storyBig: Adventure parks are receiving a 30% reduction in their business rates, providing them with additional resources to enhance and expand their facilities.
think: What would you add to a park if you could design one?
bull: Adventure parks may use savings to add exciting new rides.
bear: If savings aren't used well, parks might not improve much.
